title: 第一卷 第1627章 异妖狂第一卷 第1626章 进入沟壑
slug: 叛出家族后转身投靠魔族女帝
lines: 每天都没有什么人对他讲话。
可把他憋坏了。
今天遇到一个，可得好好聊聊。
“我之前见过异族的人员，他们有很多的分支。”
楚尘的目光之中，没有任何的惊惧，反而是一种好奇。
还寻问起异妖狂来了。
“那是当然。”
“就像你们星域之间，有着诸多的神宗一般。”
“还有很多的邪宗。”
“看似上下一心，其实内里面却是各种算计。”
“我们异魔族和异族，原来本是一族，后来发生了理念上的变化。”
“我们修炼异妖之法，算是你们星域之中的邪修异类。”
“但是谁不想占领天地元气浓郁的地方呢。”
“谁愿意苟活在不见天日的深渊之间。”
异妖狂这话，楚尘到是没有办法反驳。
“阁下，打算接下来如何？”
“把我杀了，还是放了。”
楚尘看向异妖狂。
异妖狂此时满目欣赏的看着楚尘。
“我不杀你，也不放你。”
“不如你加入我异魔族吧。”
“我们这支分支，实力上还是不错的。”
“不瞒你说，家父正是大河异魔族的异魔王。”
“乃是神魔境之上的境界。”
“强大无比。”
异妖狂目光之中带着一丝笑意看向楚尘。
“理念不同，修炼的方法不同。”
“我怎么可能加入你们呢。”
楚尘连连摇头。
“大道同归。”
“就算是前面的小分支的路不同，可是修炼的法门，必然到最后是殊途同归的。”
“只要你加入我异魔族，我大河子民，将视你为荣耀。”
异妖狂一脸笑意的看着楚尘。
等着楚尘同意呢。
可是楚尘却是显的十分的冷静，依然是摇了摇头。
这让异妖狂变的有些愤怒。
“既然你不同意，那么，你只有死路一条。”
content_en:
No one spoke to him every day.
But it suffocated him.
I met one today and had to have a good chat with him.
"I've seen members of the alien race before, and they have many branches."
There was no fear in Chu Chen's eyes, but instead a kind of curiosity.
He also asked about the strange demon maniac.
"Of course."
"Just like there are many divine sects in your star field."
"There are still many evil sects."
"It seems like everyone is united, but actually there are all kinds of calculations underneath."
"We, the alien demon clan and the alien race, were originally the same clan, but later our concepts changed."
"We practice the method of alien monsters, and we can be regarded as evil cultivators in your star field."
"But who doesn't want to occupy a place where the vitality of heaven and earth is rich?"
"Who wants to live in an abyss where the sun never shines?"
Chu Chen had no way to refute what the alien monster said.
"Your Excellency, what do you plan to do next?"
"Kill me or let me go."
Chu Chen looked at the strange monster.
The strange demon maniac looked at Chu Chen with admiration.
"I won't kill you, and I won't let you go."
"Why don't you join our alien demon clan?"
"Our branch is still quite strong in terms of strength."
"To tell you the truth, my father is the strange demon king of the Dahe strange demon clan."
"It is a realm above the realm of gods and demons."
"Incredibly powerful."
The alien monster looked at Chu Chen with a hint of smile in his eyes.
"The concepts are different, and the methods of cultivation are different."
"How could I join you."
Chu Chen shook his head repeatedly.
"The road leads to the same destination."
"Even if the paths of the previous small branches are different, the method of cultivation will inevitably lead to the same goal in the end."
"As long as you join our strange demon tribe, our people of Dahe will regard you as an honor."
The strange monster looked at Chu Chen with a smile on his face.
Waiting for Chu Chen to agree.
But Chu Chen looked very calm and still shook his head.
This made the alien monster become a little angry.
"Since you don't agree, then you will only die."
